name: What are the standard walkway clearances required for a kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What are the standard walkway clearances required for a kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearance dimensions around your kitchen work zones depend on the type of traffic and appliance door swings. Standard guidelines require a minimum of 36 inches for a single-cook aisle and 42 to 48 inches in multi-cook kitchens or in front of major appliances like the refrigerator and range. Seating overhangs at an island require at least 36 inches of clearance behind pushed-back barstools to allow someone to walk past. Inadequate clearance can lead to refrigerator doors hitting cabinet handles or preventing the dishwasher door from dropping fully open.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain at least 36 inches for standard walkways and 42 to 48 inches around primary work zones, island seating, and major appliances with swing-down doors.
